title: Inventory and Sustainability Power BI reports missing from Role Explorer despite being searchable
summary: Sustainability and Inventory Valuation Power BI reports now appear in Role Explorer by moving them from the Reporting area to the Sections area on their respective role centers.
key_points: Sustainability Manager role center Power BI Reports group moved from addlast(Reporting) to addfirst(Sections) to appear in Role Explorer
Four Inventory Valuation reports added to the Warehouse Manager role center Power BI Reports group under Sections
Reports were previously searchable but invisible in Role Explorer because they were only in the Reporting action area
Change aligns Sustainability with other Power BI role center extensions that use Sections
No business logic changes; navigation structure only
